blocks.title: Sequence diagram
blocks.text: Sequence diagrams dikhate hain ke nizam ke objects ek khaas tarteeb mein aapas mein kaise taamul karte hain. Yeh waqt ke saath objects ke darmiyan paighamat ka bahao samajhne mein madad dete hain.

Figure 1.11 kamre ki misal jaari rakhti hai. User aur teen dabbon (toys box, books box aur clothes box) ki apni amudi lifeline hai. Oopar se neeche parhe jane wale paigham yeh hain: har dabba open() karna; khilone, kitabein aur kapre apne dabbon mein daalna; phir har dabba close() karna.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: user aur teen dabbon ki lifelines wala sequence diagram, open, andar daalna aur close paigham waqt ki tarteeb mein. Oopar daen: start se order placement aur food preparation, phir ready ke faisle se delivery ya dobara tayyari, phir end tak activity diagram. Neeche baen: unit, integration, system aur acceptance testing chaurii hoti tahon ki shakal mein. Neeche daen: development tools ki qismein misalon ke saath.
blocks.caption: Sequence aur activity diagrams, testing ki satahein aur development tools (Figures 1.11 aur 1.12 aur topics 1.7 aur 1.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Sequence diagram har object ko amudi lifeline deta aur un ke darmiyan paighamat ko oopar se neeche waqt ki tarteeb mein teeron se dikhata hai: user har dabba kholta, khilone, kitabein aur kapre andar daalta, aur har dabba band karta hai. Activity diagram kisi amal ka bahao start node se qadmon aur faislon se end node tak dikhata hai: order diya jata hai, khana tayyar hota hai, aur agar tayyar ho to deliver, warna dobara tayyar hota hai. Testing akeli units se un ke mel, poore nizam aur aakhir mein users ki manzoori tak jati hai. Development tools mein editors, translators, compilers, debuggers, integrated development environments, computing platforms aur code repositories shamil hain.

blocks.prompt: Long question 5: food delivery app mein items chunne se delivery tak order dene ka sequence diagram bayan kijiye.
blocks.explanation: Lifelines: customer, app, restaurant, payment service, rider. Tarteeb se paigham: customer items chun kar order deta hai; app payment service ko payment ki darkhwast bhej kar tasdeeq leti hai; app order restaurant ko bhejti hai, jo manzoor kar ke khana tayyar karta hai; app rider muqarrar karti hai; restaurant app ko batata hai ke khana tayyar hai; rider utha kar deliver karta hai; app customer ko batati hai ke order pohanch gaya.

items: Sequence diagram: lifelines wale objects aur waqt ki tarteeb mein paigham (Fig. 1.11: har dabba open, andar daalna, close).
